proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness is most naturally read as a measurable, intrinsic relational property that inheres in an agent or a collective of agents — i.e., a quality in the BFO sense. It characterises the degree or mode of connection obtaining between or within agents at a given time, which fits BFO Quality (a specifically dependent continuant that is a measurable property of its bearer). It is not a process (it does not unfold), not a disposition (it need not be merely latent), not a role (it is not externally conferred by a social context alone), and not a generically dependent continuant (it is not an information artifact that can be copied). Typing it as a Quality sub-class leaves open whether the bearer is an individual agent or a social/institutional aggregate, to be resolved by the user.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is proposed as a sub-class of BFO Quality, capturing it as a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in an agent or agent-collective as a measurable relational property.

open_questions: Should 'agent connectedness' be understood as a quality inhering in individual agents, in pairs/groups of agents, or in a legal/social institution as a whole? This affects how we model the bearer.

Is 'agent connectedness' intended to capture a purely descriptive social-network property (e.g., degree of interconnection), or does it carry normative or functional content (e.g., the capacity to coordinate), which might instead motivate typing it as a Disposition (BFO_0000016)?
Is 'agent connectedness' a general kind (class) or a specific named property of a particular system already in the ontology (individual)?
Should AgentConnectedness be related to existing classes such as RelationalCoherence or RelationalStructure in the working ontology?
proposal.rationale_summary: The utterance asks for a BFO classification of 'agent connectedness' as a kind (common noun → class). The most defensible primary typing is Quality (BFO_0000019): agent connectedness denotes a property that inheres in one or more agents and is measurable at a time, fitting the BFO gloss for Quality. Alternative candidates are Disposition (BFO_0000016) if the concept is about a latent capacity for agents to coordinate, or a Generically Dependent Continuant (BFO_0000031) if it is conceived as an information-theoretic pattern that can be instantiated across systems. The Quality reading is chosen as the default conservative interpretation pending user clarification. The class AgentConnectedness is minted fresh; no existing working-ontology class exactly matches it, though RelationalCoherence (Quality) and RelationalStructure (GDC) are close relatives that the user may wish to relate to this new class.
